# linux_symlink (Resource)

Manages a symbolic link. A file or link already at `path` is replaced, a directory is not.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "linux_symlink" "current_release" {
  path   = "/opt/app/current"
  target = "/opt/app/releases/v1.4.2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Absolute path of the link.
- `target` (String) Path the link points to, absolute or relative to the directory of the link. It does not need to exist.

### Optional

- `create_parents` (Boolean) Create missing parent directories. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Path of the link.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the path of the link.
terraform import linux_symlink.current_release /opt/app/current
```
